senses.gloss: (b. h.; √אה, v. אוי I; cmp. אתא, אֶת, אתר, a. אָתָה; v. also Ges. H. Dict. s. v.)to join, fit.

(b. h.) to be suited, pleased, whence to be gratified, to enjoy. Y. Ber. III, 6ᶜ top ראה את עצמו נ׳ וכ׳ he dreamt he felt sexual gratification; Y. Yoma VII, 44ᵈ bot.; Y. Taan. I, 64ᶜ bot.—Y. Bets. I, 61ᵃ כל שנֵאותין בו בי״ט whatever you are permitted to make use of on Holy Days.—Fut. יֵאוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 8:6">Ber. VIII, 6</cite> <he>עד שיֵאוֹתוּ לאורו</he> until being near enough to enjoy its light. Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᶜ top, a. e., differences as to spelling <he>יֵאוֹתוּ</he> or <he>יֵעוּתוּ</he>.—Denom. <cite ref="E00678"><he>הֲנָאָה</he></cite>, <cite ref="N00010"><he>נָאֶה</he></cite>, <cite ref="N00013"><he>נָאוֶה</he></cite>, <cite ref="N00354"><he>נוֹי</he></cite>.
